title: Workflow Read Logs — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: Someone opened a request at a step where the read log is on. Written by the workflow engine as requests move; there is normally no reason to add or change entries by hand.

fields.label: WorkflowRequests
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Workflow Request master data.
fields.html: What it is. The workflow request this record belongs to.

fields.label: User
fields.html: What it is. The employee who opened it, by employee number in the system.
